# Fenrir GRC

Governance, risk and compliance programmes you can evidence. For anyone running Cyber Essentials, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS or similar programmes for themselves or their customers.

Fenrir GRC is one of the [Fenrir apps](../README.md): it runs on its own, with its own dashboard, from this
repository with `FENRIR_APP=grc`. It is free, self-hosted and released under the Apache License 2.0, as-is and
without support.

## What it does

- Governance programmes per customer with requirements and answers (UK and UK-targeted frameworks, plus importable libraries)
- Policies with an editor, versions and approval
- Evidence upload and linking to requirements
- Risk register
- Supplier (vendor) risk: assessments, document expiry, periodic reviews
- Control crosswalks between frameworks and continuous-compliance automation

## Quick start

1. Fork this repository (or copy it into a private repository) and clone **your** copy onto a Linux server.
2. Point a domain name such as `grc.yourcompany.com` at the server.
3. Run setup and choose this app:

   ```bash
   deploy/setup.sh --app grc
   ```

   Setup asks for your domain, an administrator email and your organisation's name, writes `deploy/.env` with fresh
   secrets, and can build and start the server.
4. Open `https://grc.yourcompany.com` and sign in with the email and the password setup printed.

The [full guide](GUIDE.md) covers every step in detail, first use, each page, configuration, updates, backups and
troubleshooting.

## The dashboard

| Menu | Page | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| Home | **Dashboard** | The app's headline numbers and a way into each of its pages. |
| Governance | **Compliance & GRC** | UK and UK-targeted governance programmes with requirements, answers, policies, evidence, a risk register and supplier (vendor) risk. |
| Governance | **Continuous compliance** | Controls checked automatically against live evidence, with drift raised when a passing control starts failing. |
| Admin | **Settings** | Customers (tenants), users and roles, custom fields, region and holidays, webhooks, API credentials, approvals, the audit log and platform options. |

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Server | Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS on amd64 recommended), 2 vCPUs, 4 GB RAM plus 4 GB swap, 40 GB SSD. The server image is the same for every app, so the first build still compiles the agents once (it takes a while; later builds reuse it). |
| Software | Docker Engine with buildx and Docker Compose 2.24.4 or newer, Git, curl, OpenSSL, Bash, Python 3. |
| Network | A domain name (DNS A record) pointing at the server; TCP 80 and 443 open; SSH restricted to you. |
| Signing | Not needed: this app has no device agents. |

## Not in this app

Live device evidence (the **rmm**, **av** and **vuln** apps) and tickets (**psa**). The **complete** platform feeds them into continuous compliance automatically. To add another app later, switch to `FENRIR_APP=complete` (see [the guide](GUIDE.md#adding-more-apps-later)); your data is kept.
